_notes: Lane LOOK look data. Read by Scripts/LookData.cs (StreamingAssets copy first, then Assets/Data). exposure is the ONE scene exposure: HdrpScene bakes it into HDRP_Global, RuntimeQuality re-applies it to every Volume with an Exposure override at player boot (runtime_flags exposureEV is no longer used), and lockFinisher = true stops the finisher camera adding its own exposure override (darkenEV / per-shot offsets are ignored), so gameplay and finisher shots use the same EV. contactShadows: Volume override added to HDRP_Global (the key light opts in via hdrp_lighting_ultra.json shadow.contact). post / fog / dynamicRes / runtime / gltfMats / charMats: values that used to be hard-coded in HdrpScene, HdrpSetup, RuntimeQuality, HdrpGltfMats and HdrpCharMats, with identical defaults (enum names: TonemappingMode, FilmGrainLookup, FogDenoisingMode, HDAdditionalCameraData.AntialiasingMode). ground: material-only tiling breakup applied by Editor/HdrpGroundLook.cs (normalScale absolute, -1 = leave; detailTiling = UV scale of the generated macro detail map, 0 = no detail; detailAlbedo / detailSmoothness = HDRP detail strengths 0..2). Tune detailTiling by eye: paving UV scale is unknown, terrain UV 1 = 64 m.
